target.definition: Number of live births in South Korea during July 2026, as first reported in the national statistics agency's monthly Population Trends release.

inputs.name: annual_births_2025
inputs.description: Total live births in South Korea in calendar year 2025

provenance.rationale: Recent annual birth counts have been around 230k-250k; 2025 likely similar with slight recovery.

inputs.name: july_share_of_annual_births
inputs.description: Fraction of annual live births that occur in July

provenance.rationale: July is near the annual average; monthly shares typically range 7.5%-9.5%.

inputs.name: monthly_births_2025_avg
inputs.description: Average monthly live births in South Korea in 2025

provenance.rationale: Annual 2025 births divided by 12; consistent with recent monthly figures.

inputs.name: july_seasonal_index
inputs.description: Seasonal index for July relative to average month (1.0 = average)

provenance.rationale: July births are close to the annual average; index near 1.0 with modest uncertainty.

inputs.name: births_per_day
inputs.description: Average number of live births per day in South Korea in 2025

provenance.rationale: Annual births divided by 365; recent daily average around 600-700.

inputs.name: days_in_july
inputs.description: Number of days in July

inputs.name: july_daily_factor
inputs.description: Factor adjusting average daily births for July-specific daily rate

provenance.rationale: July daily birth rate is close to the annual average; factor near 1.0.

inputs.name: population_sk
inputs.description: Population of South Korea in 2026

inputs.name: annual_birth_rate_per_1000
inputs.description: Annual live births per 1000 people in South Korea in 2026

provenance.rationale: Crude birth rate has been around 4.5-5.0 in recent years.

inputs.name: july_share_of_year
inputs.description: Fraction of the year that July represents, adjusted for seasonality

provenance.rationale: July's share of annual births is near 1/12 but with seasonal variation.

paths.description: Estimate annual births for 2025 and multiply by July's share of annual births.
Use average monthly births in 2025 and adjust for July seasonality.
Scale from daily birth rate over the number of days in July.

problems: path p2: dimension mismatch: formula gives s**-1, target is dimensionless
